turns.replyTail:
tween your top two gift ideas, which feels more special?
menu
Between the two, a quality bike bag (like a saddle bag or frame/bikepacking bag) usually feels more “special” because it’s something they’ll notice every ride and it’s a bit more gift-y than consumables.
Tools & maintenance is the most universally useful, but it tends to feel more practical than special. If you tell me which style they ride (road, gravel, MTB, commuter), I’ll narrow it to the best picks in that range.
